newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Abtrust Singapore renamed Aberdeen Asia.
newsitem.headline: Abtrust Singapore renamed Aberdeen Asia.

text.p: Abtrust Fund Managers (Singapore) Ltd said on Friday it had changed its name to Aberdeen Asset Management Asia Ltd.
The company, which manages around US$1 billion in funds, said the change would bring it into line with its parent Aberdeen Asset Management Plc.
Managing director Hugh Young said the company had increased the funds under its management in Singapore by five fold over the last five years and aimed to boost them further in the next few years.

"The group has been structured to take on two or three times the amount of funds currently under management. We would hope to double or treble it...over the next two or three years," Young told reporters at a briefing.
He said the company was considering possible joint ventures with other financial institutions in Asia and planned to make an announcement on a partnership in Malaysia in the near future.
He said the possible Malaysian partner was a bank which already managed money successfully. He declined to give further details but said an announcement would be made "as soon as the ink is dry".
